thread:
emma_support: heads up — enterprise-corp reporting intermittent 401/403 after we rotated their API key yesterday evening. A subset of requests started failing ~10m after rotation and then flapped for ~2 hours. They see both 401 and 403 depending on endpoint. stack: hosted API, dedicated pool in eu-west-1.

Diego_platform: thanks. do we have a correlation with which model or route? token scopes?

emma_support: mostly generation routes (/v1/engines/*/completions) and a few embeddings calls. They said older pods returned 403 while some requests hit healthy pods and worked.

olivia_security: could be key revocation propagation. Which secret store did they use for their rotated key? vault or env var?

emma_support: they rotated via our Console -> Key rotation (Vault-backed). We created a new key entry in vault (kv-v2) and marked the old key as revoked. They confirmed rotation in UI at 2026-11-03T19:12Z.

maria_infra: can we get the gateway logs for that customer? any 401 detail? also any sidecar cache TTL mismatch?

emma_support: pasted logs from the edge:```
[2026-11-03T19:22:14Z] tenant=enterprise-corp path=/v1/engines/gptx/completions status=403 reason="api_key_revoked" node=eu-west-1-edge-3
[2026-11-03T19:22:14Z] tenant=enterprise-corp path=/v1/embeddings status=200 key_id=k_20261103_new node=eu-west-1-edge-1
[2026-11-03T19:25:03Z] tenant=enterprise-corp path=/v1/engines/gptx/completions status=401 reason="auth_failed" node=eu-west-1-edge-2
[2026-11-03T19:25:18Z] tenant=enterprise-corp path=/v1/engines/gptx/completions status=403 reason="api_key_revoked" node=eu-west-1-edge-4
```

aaron_sre: interesting. looks like some edges saw new key, some still using old cached key which was revoked. could be: 1) vault KV version mismatch (kv-v2 metadata/versions), 2) sidecar secret cache not invalidating on rotation, or 3) routing to different model variants that reference different key ids.

kevin_engineer: checked vault audit — there was a rewrap operation that took ~90s to finish for some keys due to KMS throttling. relevant logs:```
2026-11-03T19:12:05Z vault: write kv/data/ent/enterprise-corp k=rotation payload=...
2026-11-03T19:12:07Z vault: request to kms rewrap start key=k_20261103_new
2026-11-03T19:13:41Z vault: kms rewrap completed key=k_20261103_new status=ok
```
kevin_engineer: so there was a ~94s window where the new key entry existed but was not fully rewrapped/available in all backend nodes. some of our sidecars query local vault caches and might have polled during the partial state.

maria_infra: do we have sidecar refresh strategy? I think sidecar reads vault every N seconds and also subscribes to webhook notifications but webhooks are best-effort. if webhook missed a node, that node will keep the old key until TTL. what's the TTL?

diego_platform: current sidecar cache TTL is 300s (5m) and webhook invalidation is enabled but we saw delivery drops in eu-west-1 ~5% recently (network flaps). that fits.

olivia_security: customer is worried about denial of service and wants assurance keys won't be partially invalidated in the future. can we propose mitigations?

aaron_sre: short-term: ask them to perform rotation during a low-traffic window and run a staged rotation pattern (create new key, wait 2-3 minutes, then mark old key revoked). Also we can do a targeted gateway purge:```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset edge-proxy-eu-west-1
# or use our edge control plane to flush key cache for tenant enterprise-corp
```

kevin_engineer: long-term: reduce sidecar TTL to 60s, improve webhook retry/backoff, and add a two-phase rotation in Console (CREATE -> READY -> REVOKE) where READY waits for vault/KMS convergence across nodes. Also surface a logs flag in Console indicating "all nodes observed new key".

emma_support: i already asked the customer to run a restart on their worker fleet (they have some on-prem connectors) — they did restart and failures dropped to near zero after ~6 minutes. they also asked for a timeline of what happened.

maria_infra: note for internal runbook: when handling rotation flaps do: 1) check vault audit for write and kms rewrap times, 2) look at edge logs per node, 3) check sidecar webhook delivery in infra-observability, 4) offer targeted cache purge or daemonset restart, 5) offer staged rotation guidance to customer.

vault-bot: INFO: vault cluster event: kv-v2 write by user=console-rotation actor=console service_time=2026-11-03T19:12:05Z version=2 change_id=chg_92471

deploy-bot: INFO: triggered rolling restart on edge-proxy-eu-west-1 (requested by maria_infra) at 2026-11-03T19:28:10Z

diego_platform: follow-up action items: - update Console UI copy to show KMS rewrap latency note - add a toggle for two-phase rotation for enterprise customers - default TTL reduction to 60s for sidecars in EU regions (but we'll need perf test)

olivia_security: i want to add an approval gate for rotations for customers with dedicated pools — maybe require explicit confirm for immediate revocation. will sync with product.

emma_support: customer happy with the restart and a follow-up doc. they asked if we can detect these partial-propagation windows automatically and put rotation into a "pending" state.

kevin_engineer: doable — we can emit a convergence webhook from vault when KMS rewrap completes across primaries and secondaries. won't be trivial but doable.

emma_support: great — i'll relay. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria_infra: adding note: label this thread with incident: rotation-propagation and assign to diego for follow-up work items.

aaron_sre: marking follow-up: create runbook entry + automation to purge tenant key cache via edge control plane.

kevin_engineer: created GH issue: rfd/rotation-convergence-checks #842 (WIP)

emma_support: closing loop with customer, will reopen if they see any new failures.
